title: Wizard page
summary: A multi-step flow on a page: a pk-stepper for progress, one step's fields at a time as a validated pk-form (or your own content through mountStep), and Back, Next and Submit. Next is blocked until the step's fields are valid and validate(stepId, values) passes; what was typed is kept when you go back; focus moves to the step heading on every step change. An optional Review step lists every answer before Submit. Set validate, submit, load and mountStep as properties (business logic, never config data). Reject or return { errors: { field: message } } to mark fields inline (a submit may name a field of an earlier step: the wizard goes back to it), or any other error for a notice. While answers are unsent, dirty is true, pk-wizard-dirty fires, and closing or reloading the tab asks first.

props.name: config
props.description: { steps, review?, reviewLabel?, submitLabel?, doneHeading?, doneDescription?, label? }. steps is [{ id, label, description?, fields? }]: fields is [{ name, label?, type?, required?, help?, options? }] (type is a pk-input type, 'textarea' or 'select'); a step without fields is drawn by mountStep. review: true adds a last step that lists all answers.

props.name: dirty
props.description: Answers were typed and not yet submitted. Read it; the element sets it.

events.name: pk-wizard-dirty
events.description: The unsent-answers state changed. An app that owns its router uses it to confirm before leaving.

events.name: pk-wizard-submit
events.description: submit() resolved; values are all the answers.

parts.name: stepper
parts.description: The pk-stepper showing progress; a reached step can be clicked to go back.

parts.name: card
parts.description: The pk-card holding the heading, the step and the buttons.

parts.name: heading
parts.description: The current step's heading; it receives focus on every step change.

parts.name: panes
parts.description: One pane per visited step; the others are hidden, not removed.

parts.name: bar
parts.description: Wraps Back and Next or Submit.

parts.name: next
parts.description: The Next button (Submit on the last step); busy while validate() or submit() runs.

parts.name: notice
parts.description: The step or submit error, above the card.

parts.name: state
parts.description: The loading or load error state before the first step, and the done message after Submit.

writes.target: the pk-field elements the step forms build in this element's own shadow tree
writes.why: A validate or submit that rejects with { errors } sets each named field's error, and the next attempt clears them. The fields are rebuilt with the wizard, so nothing outlives the element.

writes.target: the step panes this element draws in its own shadow tree
writes.why: Each visited step keeps its pane (so answers survive Back); only the current one is shown. The panes are created by this element and removed with it.

a11y: Fields are labelled pk-field controls; pk-form moves focus to the first invalid field and lists the problems in a summary, and a server error focuses its field. Focus moves to the step heading (an h2) on every step change so a keyboard or screen reader user starts at the new step; Enter in a field is Next. pk-stepper announces 'Step n of m' with its state.

examples.title: Sign-up in three steps with a review (set validate and submit from script: an inline script cannot run under this site's CSP)
